test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

The Government was / deaf on the protests and / continued with its plan.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in this sentence lies in the preposition used. The phrase **"deaf on the protests and" **is incorrect.
 
• The phrase should be **"deaf to the protests and".**
 
• **"Deaf to"** is a well-established idiom in English, meaning to ignore or refuse to acknowledge something.
 
• Therefore, the idiomatically correct prepositional phrase should be **"deaf to the protests".**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 ('continued with its plan'), Option 2 ('The Government was'), and Option 3 ('No error') are all grammatically correct and appropriate in their context.
 
• The error does not fall into these parts of the sentence.
